# This is a .gitignore style file for 'GrantBirki/json-yaml-validate' Action workflow

# Every tsconfig here is JSONC: TypeScript reads comments there, a strict JSON parser does
# not. The comments explain why the settings are what they are, and they are worth more
# than a check that only ever said these files are not the format they were never in.
# The pattern covers `tsconfig.vue.json` and anything added beside it later.
tsconfig*.json
